items.title: Live: Iran says it has struck US bases in Bahrain and Kuwait after Trump restarts attacks
items.description: Tehran says it has struck US military infrastructure in the Middle East after Washington fired a fresh series of strikes against Iran to "degrade their ability to threaten freedom of navigation" in the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: 'Pretty cool': Trump announces win for Ukraine amid fiery NATO meeting
items.description: Donald Trump says his country will probably continue to attack Iran and says Ukraine will be given permission to manufacture much-needed Patriot missiles as it fights Russia's full-scale invasion.

items.title: Praise and protests as Modi arrives in Melbourne
items.description: A large swathe of the Indian diaspora wants to warmly welcome Narendra Modi to Melbourne, but others demand Australia put pressure on him over his human rights record.

items.title: External oversight of ABC needs overhaul, Segal tells royal commission
items.description: Australia's Envoy to Combat Antisemitism, Jillian Segal, has accused the ABC of being its own "judge, counsel and jury", recommending an independent oversight committee be established to review the public broadcaster's compliance with its charter obligations.

items.title: Live: Angus Taylor backs shadow minister for test calling Triple Zero
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has backed Sarah Henderson's decision to test call Triple Zero, saying she was "doing her job". Follow live.

items.title: Telstra Triple Zero calls still impacted by 'secondary issue'
items.description: Telstra says work is ongoing to resolve a "secondary issue" impacting customers trying to make calls on its network, including to Triple Zero, but some people may still be unable to contact the emergency service.

items.title: FIFA boss referred to Olympics ethics board over Trump World Cup call
items.description: Gianni Infantino's close ties with Donald Trump continue to land him in hot water after the US President's World Cup intervention.

items.title: Growers push to overturn ban on ancient 'superfood'
items.description: Farmers are appealing against a federal ban on the sale of Moringa oleifera as a food after a regulatory body determined there was insufficient evidence to prove its safety.

items.title: Neil the seal may have left Tasmania, wildlife experts say
items.description: Authorities in Tasmania say it appears Neil the seal may have left his resting spot at a Hobart beach and returned to sea.

items.title: The key ingredient keeping the snow season alive
items.description: Data shows snow depth has been declining in Australia since the 1950s, with resorts turning to snowmaking to guarantee a strong ski season.

items.title: Judge approves $8m payment to E Jean Carroll in Trump sex abuse case
items.description: A Manhattan judge orders the payment to the former Elle magazine advice columnist, who a jury found was sexually abused by Donald Trump.

items.title: 'Important' Aboriginal language statement released amid 'abysmal' loss
items.description: Aboriginal language custodians release a road map for the survival and revival of Northern Territory Indigenous languages.

items.title: Racist commentary called out in World Cup coverage
items.description: Leading experts say racial stereotypes in World Cup coverage can be damaging for athletes' leadership aspirations and have an impact on Black communities more broadly.

items.title: New Blues bash brothers blame each other for beautiful crazy
items.description: Liam Martin and Hudson Young don't like to point fingers, unless it comes time to decide which of the New South Wales backrowers is madder.

items.title: Rob Reiner nominated for posthumous Emmy for The Bear
items.description: Plus Connor Storrie nabs his first nom but not for Heated Rivalry, Hacks soars on a swan song and more successes, surprises and snubs from today's Emmy nominations.

items.title: The grief of childlessness will always be with me
items.description: The grief of losing the chance to have baby is something I expect to carry forever. But I'm becoming more comfortable with the unconventional life I'm building with my partner April.

items.title: TV catchphrase quiz: Guess the show from the famous quote
items.description: Now for the story of 20 famous TV quotes, and the one quiz that had no choice but to keep them all together.

items.title: Water in the air an 'untapped water resource' until now
items.description: Can water be made from air in WA's wheatbelt? Researchers are putting an invention to the test.

items.title: ‘Going to make it double’: Boxer’s jokes about domestic violence condemned
items.description: A leading violence prevention organisation says an Australian boxer's joke about domestic violence is unacceptable.

items.title: Record fine for gold miner thrusts tiny bat into spotlight
items.description: A Western Australian gold miner has been hit with a fine of more than $100,000 for failing to protect a vulnerable bat species.

items.title: 'We'll sell his body parts': AI extortionists target missing man's parents
items.description: Scammers have sent the parents of a missing West Australian man an AI-generated image of their son and demanded thousands of dollars in exchange for his safety.

items.title: Australians face record-high rents as agents see 'inquiries flooding in'
items.description: Rents are soaring in several capital cities as low vacancy rates collide with rising interest rates and population growth.

items.title: Streets reopen around New York high-rise after buckled beams stabilised
items.description: A Midtown Manhattan high-rise being converted into apartments has been stabilised after buckling support columns triggered evacuations and fears of a collapse.

items.title: Farmers search for ways to break free from controversial herbicide
items.description: Australia buys most of its paraquat from China, but is investigating ways to become less reliant on the chemical.

items.title: Trainee surgeon pleads guilty to secretly filming hundreds of victims
items.description: Ryan Cho pleaded guilty to 13 charges including stalking, producing an intimate image and installing an optical surveillance device.
